item.title: Self-Hosted BGP Monitoring Protocol (BMP) Collectors: GoBGP, ExaBGP, and OpenBGPD
item.description: The BGP Monitoring Protocol (BMP, RFC 7854) provides a standardized mechanism for collecting BGP routing information from routers without requiring direct CLI access or SNMP polling. BMP collectors receive real-time updates about BGP peers, route advertisements, and route withdrawals, enabling network operators to build comprehensive monitoring and analytics platforms.
